# Open choices: technical-writing

`aidd-team:technical-writing` leaves these decisions to the team. aidd's default holds until a `standards` entry fills one. `aidd standard list` names the library standards for each choice, and `aidd standard add` adopts one.

| Choice | Question | aidd's default | Options |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `docs-site` | Where are the project's docs published? | In the repository alone: a person writes the docs as Markdown or MDX there, and the files stay the one source. A site is opt-in, never a default, and it only publishes those files. When the team wants one, prefer Mintlify. It serves an `llms.txt` and a Markdown copy of every page for agents, `mint dev` previews locally, and `mint validate` and `mint broken-links` can run in CI. It is a hosted, paid service, so the docs go to its servers over the network. MkDocs Material or Starlight build the same files into a site the team hosts itself. | the repository alone, Mintlify, MkDocs Material, Starlight |
